Text: Select a reel to roll a new random number.
Add 1 to a reel (9 becomes 0)
Subtract 1 from a reel (0 becomes 9)
Replace a digit with 9 minus that digit.
Pick two different digits to switch.
Double a digit, keeping only the last digit.
Select a reel to copy, then a different reel to copy onto.
Select a reel to reroll, then reroll the reels next to it.
Respin all reels.
Set any reel to 7.
Set any reel to 8.
Copy a reel's digit to both its neighbors.
Permanently replace a reel slot with a Bomb (starting at 3). Landing on a bomb counts it down, and bombs exploding removes the reel slot altogether and gives you +$100!
Permanently replace a reel slot with a W. Landing on a W gives you double the cash bonus for the round.
Activate a trinket's ablity.
Remove a slot from a reel, permanently.
Permanently increase a number on a reel.
Permanently clone a number on a reel.
Spend $30 to give another tool one more use this spin.
Fix a reel at its current value for the next spin.
Permanently replace a slot on a reel with a Superposition, which lets you choose between whether it's a zero or a one.
Permanently change a trinket into another of the same rarity.
Permanently change a trinket into another with one higher rarity.
Add 1 to ALL reels (9 becomes 0).
Subtract 1 from ALL reels (0 becomes 9).
